name: Certified Junior Gardener Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Volunteer on the farm every other Sunday. You plant, harvest, compost, weed and build garden beds. You also learn about hydroponics, farm animals and forests. You learn about pollination too.
who_can_apply: Middle and high school students ages 12 to 18. Only the student should fill out the application, not a parent.
pay_detail: Unpaid and free. No admission fee. You earn a certificate if you attend at least 13 of 16 sessions.
duration: 9 months of select Sundays, 1 to 3 p.m. 2026-27 dates: Oct 11 through June 6, 2027. Certification ceremony June 20.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed Oct 3, 2026 (acceptances Oct 6, 2026). An open house was held Sept 27. The next call is not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the form on the program page. Applications only, no walk-ins.
notes: Popular program with an acceptance step and a waitlist. Mostly outdoors, weather permitting. The museum is the Queens County Farm Museum.
